name: Poly Haven

website.tagline: CC0 HDRIs, PBR textures and 3D models — the lighting layer for any 3D scene
website.description: Search and pull from Poly Haven's public CC0 library: ~980 HDR environment maps, ~785 PBR texture sets, ~520 models. No key, no attribution, and licensed so assets can be rehosted and shipped anywhere. Image-based lighting from one HDRI is the difference between a 3D view that reads as a product render and one that reads as a toy.
useCases: Light a 3D scene with an industrial workshop HDRI
Pull a concrete floor PBR set for a factory view
Browse and add environment maps from the Add Asset picker

contextMessage: Poly Haven is available (no key needed): polyhaven_search finds CC0 HDRIs, PBR textures and models; polyhaven_files resolves web-sized download URLs. Everything is CC0 — free to rehost and ship. For a 3D view: one HDRI as scene.environment plus ACESFilmic tone mapping does most of the work; prefer a texture's packed `arm` map over separate AO/roughness maps.

tools.name: polyhaven_search
tools.description: Search Poly Haven's CC0 library of HDR environment maps, PBR textures, and 3D models. Everything is CC0 — free to use, rehost, and ship, no attribution required. Returns {slug, name, type, tags, categories, authors, max_resolution, thumbnail_url}. Use the slug with polyhaven_files to get download URLs, or as external_id when adding a polyhaven asset to a scene. Good queries: 'workshop industrial' (HDRIs), 'concrete floor' (textures).

query.description: Text matched against slug, name, tags and categories. Omit to list everything of a type.

tools.name: polyhaven_files
tools.description: Resolve download URLs for a Poly Haven slug at a given resolution. HDRIs return the environment map; textures return the PBR maps (diffuse, normal, roughness, ao, displacement, and the packed `arm`); models return glTF (with the `includes` sidecar list), USD and FBX. Defaults are web-sized — 1k HDR and 2k JPG — since image-based lighting prefilters the HDRI anyway; ask for 4k+ only for offline rendering.

type.description: 'hdris' | 'textures' | 'models'. Optional — inferred from the slug if omitted.

tools.name: polyhaven_info
tools.description: Full metadata for one Poly Haven asset: display name, tags, categories, authors, max resolution, publish date. Use polyhaven_files for download URLs.

tools.name: polyhaven_browse
tools.description: Browse the library for the asset picker (internal — not an LLM tool).
